identity_model: Three-layer stack per ADR-0010: token layer (OSHB ids in occurrences), lexeme layer (canonical id = Strong's for the pilot; homograph-suffixed only when split), legacy crosswalk (strongs). Full ETCBC-style homograph numbering arrives with Macula/BHSA; schema is forward-compatible.
honesty_rules: OSHB n-attribute stored verbatim as counts, never as identity (unreliable as homograph signal).
TBESH variants verbatim; generator never decides sense — the review workflow does.
Homograph field is the one curated human input, seeded unresolved with candidate senses (option A); splits only when a conflicting occurrence appears in scope.
Theological prose per lexeme deferred indefinitely (thin human layer).
